issues.text: New in round 2. "from release 2" is a qualifier I cannot place: neither this lesson nor the prerequisite summaries say what release 2 is, or how staff read before it. It makes me wonder whether shops are kept apart at all before release 2. It does not block the quiz or Try it item 2.

issues.text: New in round 2.
